title: Comali
desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.

title: Gajaana
desc: On an adventurous search for treasure in the dense forest, a group of young explorers soon discovers they have become the quarry.

title: Aathi
desc: A young boy moves to Chennai for his education where he meets a girl and falls in love with her. Soon, they learn that they are both on a mission to avenge the death of their parents.

title: Aadikeshava
desc: Following the death of his biological father, a man travels to Rayalaseema to protect his sister and his ancestral temple.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.
